title: Characters unreadable, then crash
body: ### Tested versions Godot 4.7 Beta 3 ### System information Godot v4.7.beta3 - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960M (NVK GM107) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700HQ CPU @ 2.60GHz (8 threads) - 15.42 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description I'm developing on a notebook (XPS 15 9550) the same project I've been developing in other PCs (a Steam Deck running SteamOS and a Desktop PC running Fedora 44, too). This happens when using Godot 4.7 Beta 3 in the XPS notebook only.
